scientific_scope_status: The acquired review accepts almost-sure exact integer-bin pushforward of the declared Maxwell/covariance-mixture model under iid fair bits and convergent outward Arb/acb arithmetic. Persistent uniform prefixes and strict refinements avoid resampling unresolved choices; the fixed rational four-rotation kernel and positive singleton program are consumed explicitly. The same review accepts an ordinary finite-accuracy equilibrium alternative with an exponentially decaying transient TV bound.
